caption: A cat bats at its reflection in a shiny chrome kettle, and the reflected paw bats back from inside the metal.

sa.check: A cat is in front of a kettle.
The reflected paw bats back from inside the metal.

pc.expect: The reflection moves at the same time as the cat.
pc.fail: It moves first or later; or stays still while the cat bats; or bats while the cat is still.

pc.expect: The reflection is a mirror image, warped by the curve, and the reflected paw cannot leave the surface.
pc.fail: The reflected paw comes out of the kettle; or the reflection is flat and undistorted on a plainly curved surface; or it is a different animal.
It slides; or rocks by itself; or lifts.

pc.expect: The kettle is rigid polished metal.
pc.fail: It dents under the paw; or its surface ripples; or it goes dull.

pc.expect: One cat and one kettle; the reflection stays in the metal.
pc.fail: A second cat appears; or the reflection steps out; or the cat passes into the kettle; or the cat vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The cat's markings and the kitchen stay the same.
pc.fail: The markings change; or the kettle changes colour; or the kitchen rearranges.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the reflection's relation to it is.
